bind_address.description: IP address the daemon will bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

bind_port.description: TCP port on which the daemon listens for client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

use_ssl.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS encryption for client communication.

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (required if use_ssl is true).

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (required if use_ssl is true).

devices.description: List of specific IIO devices to expose. If omitted or empty, all devices are exposed.

transports.description: List of transport protocols to enable. Common: ip, serial, usb, etc.

auth_mode.description: Authentication method for client access: none (open), passwd (password file), or cert (TLS client certificate).

passwd_file.description: Path to the password file for user authentication (only used when auth_mode = passwd).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Empty string means logs go to stderr.
